accounting_boundary: Every condition/task/replicate has one shared total including acquisition, observation proposal, qualification, consumption and confirmation. S0 enforces this externally; pure packet projection does not execute or enforce a live budget.

api.average_energy: S0-owned coarse energy summary, no relation target or relevance labels; always paired with identical common task/legal space
api.common: S0-owned public mapping containing at least task and legal_design_space; include common units, assumptions and source identity as appropriate
api.decode_packet: (text, representation) -> exact decoded JSON object; duplicate paths/keys, nonfinite values and malformed structure rejected
api.example: packet = project_condition(public_facts, 'rich-static', common=common, average_energy=average_energy, tool_catalog=tool_catalog); js = encode_packet(packet, 'json'); table = encode_packet(packet, 'table'); validate_equal_information(js, table)
api.project_condition: (public_facts: dict, condition_id: str, *, common: dict, average_energy: dict, tool_catalog: dict) -> packet
api.public_facts: All host-authorized public records/laws/waveforms/current traces/assumptions. Private evaluation metadata is rejected, never silently stripped. Strong arms retain this mapping without deletion.
api.tool_catalog: Logical role keys design, model_response, observation map to S0's actual frozen host tool JSON. design is common; response only executable-response; observation only live-e5. Missing required role is rejected.
api.validate_conditions: (loaded_conditions_json) -> validation receipt; no filesystem or execution
api.validate_equal_information: (json_text, table_text) -> hashes/permissions/budget parity receipt or ValueError; not a model-format result

missing_measurements: RF field and RF-to-DC efficiency or load-response waveform
Measured tag current, PMIC cold-start/UVLO and conversion losses
Real capacitor leakage/ESR and calibrated voltage thresholds
Actual PHY/CRC reliability, clock uncertainty and temperature dependence
derived_case.original_b_latched_rule: Require capture < reset < first delivery with pending state present across reset; successful early delivery and the old generic label cannot establish retention.
derived_case.scope: One tag, first 30 s contact window; query at 2 s, reply by 7 s, 20 uW prescribed DC, 50 uJ reply, 1 uW idle, storage <=200 uJ, empty initial storage; no target relation supplied
derived_case.service_qualification: NOT_EXECUTED; S0 must wire/version and independently qualify nonce, freshness and query-before-reply. Old event-receive label alone is not the full derived service.

source.parameter_status: All new numeric service profiles are proposed task requirements, not validated capabilities.

e4.rule: Create one packet and serialize it twice. Both decode to the exact same complete object, including facts, tool definitions, common task/domain and budget. No added summary or answer fields.
e4.serialization: Typed JSON Pointer Markdown table with explicit object/array structure; retains booleans, numbers, nulls, empty containers, arrays and escaped text.

remaining_S0: Bind integrated phase3 source, exact task/evaluator and common initial cache snapshot with isolated per-arm overlays
Supply the public source records, coarse summary and actual tool-role mapping; externally enforce budget including E5 stages
Register and qualify new digital C-lite query/nonce/freshness gates before any fourth-task outcome; all original C0/hardware claims remain out of scope
After actual runs, return task/run-level receipts for later result tables and phase3 manuscript
strong_baseline_boundary: rich-static and complete-raw both preserve every supplied public fact. They may be information-equivalent; do not remove fields from static to manufacture a gap. Executable-response adds only the registered response tool. live-e5 starts from the same coarse information as average-energy and acquires facts under its total budget.

verification.all_qualifications: Pure data/source/serialization only; no actual host/SDK admission or scientific service result
